name: renew-before
description: Read your local subscription, cancellation and payment evidence in Claude. No hosted database or paid API.
long_description: Engineering preview: reads a previously generated private Gmail evidence report. Gmail scanning and automatic updates require separate setup and are not enabled by installing this reader.

data_directory.title: Your private evidence folder
data_directory.description: Select the folder containing your snapshot.json and evidence.json. The reader cannot browse other folders.
